How can I change only the color of a vase in a photo using an AI image editing prompt? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
To change only the color of a vase in a photo using AI, you need to use an AI image editor with "Inpainting" or "AI Replace" capabilities. These tools allow you to isolate a specific object so the AI modifies its color while preserving the lighting, shadows, and the rest of your original image. 
Canva
 +4
Here is the sequential guide to achieving this:
1. Select and Prepare Your Image Editor
Choose an AI-powered image editing platform that supports localized text-prompt modifications. Popular options include:
Canva AI Replace: Uses a brush tool alongside text prompts to substitute elements.
Picsart AI Replace: Seamlessly swaps or updates object colors and textures while maintaining background continuity.
Higgsfield AI Inpainting: Offers a smart brush tool tailored for targeted text edits.
Aragon AI Object Recolor: Specializes strictly in color-switching workflows. 
Higgsfield AI
 +3
2. Isolate the Vase (Masking)
Once you upload your photo, you must tell the AI where to apply the change to avoid altering the flowers, table, or background: 
Aragon.ai
 +1
Manual Masking: Use the tool's built-in smart brush or selection lasso to paint completely over the vase.
Auto Selection: If the tool features automatic object recognition, type "vase" or select it from the auto-detected categories so the AI auto-masks the object boundaries. 
YouTube
·Creator Canvas
 +2
3. Write a Clear, Direct Prompt
AI image editors work best with short, descriptive instructions rather than long, conversational text. Avoid overcomplicating the prompt. 
YouTube
·Magnific
Effective Prompt Examples:
"Change the color of the vase to emerald green."
"A matte blue ceramic vase."
"Modify the white vase to a glossy crimson red vase." 
Kling AI
 +2
4. Generate and Refine
Click Generate. The AI will process the request (usually taking anywhere from a few seconds to half a minute) and provide a few variations. 
YouTube
·Sketchaa Merch Design
 +2
Check the lighting: Platforms like Aragon AI automatically adjust the new color to match the original environment shadows, making it look natural. 
Aragon.ai
Adjust if needed: If the flowers or background are bleeding into the new color, undo the action, refine your brush mask boundaries, and regenerate. Once satisfied, export your high-resolution image.

 +2
